blocks.t: **Objetivo de comunicação (C1):** eu consigo reconhecer e imitar a estrutura de um relatório (Introduction, Findings, Conclusions, Recommendations) a partir de uma resenha de relatório.

body: Esta aula treina **ler textos curtos e achar informação (IELTS Reading, TOEFL Reading)**.

blocks.t: Toque em 🔊, ouça e repita cada palavra. Depois tente adivinhar o sentido.

frames.title: Reading · A review of a report

blocks.title: Review: “Remote Teams: Findings and Recommendations” ★★★★☆
paras: This clear report follows the standard structure. The **Introduction** states the aim; **Findings** are presented with figures; **Conclusions** summarize the evidence; and **Recommendations** are practical. **Scarcely any** section is padded.
Its main weakness is the sample: only 60 firms took part. Nonetheless, **it is recommended that** managers set clear goals, **and that** meetings be shortened.

blocks.body: Relatórios usam **títulos**, **linguagem impessoal** (passiva) e **dados**. Para recomendar: **it is recommended that + base**.

items.s: The ___ of this report is to review remote work. (aim)
The survey ___ that 60% prefer hybrid work. (show)
It is recommended that managers ___ clear goals. (set)

blocks.title: Match the word to its meaning

items.ans: How do we make a recommendation

body: **The aim of this report is…** — O objetivo deste relatório é…
**It can be concluded that…** — Pode-se concluir que…
**Figures indicate that…** — Os números indicam que…
**Attention should be drawn to…** — Deve-se chamar a atenção para…
**In view of the above,…** — Diante do exposto,…
**It is advisable that…** — É aconselhável que…
**Further action is required.** — É necessária mais ação.
**As outlined above,…** — Como descrito acima,…
**Introduction, findings, conclusions and recommendations.** — Introdução, resultados, conclusões e recomendações.
**How do we make a recommendation?** — Como fazemos uma recomendação?
**What are the main sections of a report?** — Quais as seções principais de um relatório?

items.label: Ênfase intencional
items.note: A ênfase intencional destaca a palavra que carrega o sentido: sílaba forte, mais longa e mais alta. Mudar a palavra enfatizada muda a mensagem.
words: I didn’t say HE stole it.
I didn’t SAY he stole it.
Not only did she COME, she LED.

prompts.model: The aim of this report is to assess costs.
The survey shows that most staff prefer flexibility.
It is recommended that meetings be shortened.

blocks.task: Write a short report (Introduction, Findings, Conclusions, Recommendations) of 8 sentences on meeting length.
blocks.model: Introduction: The aim of this report is to examine meeting length. Findings: The survey shows that meetings average 70 minutes. Most staff say they lose focus after 30. Conclusions: Long meetings reduce productivity. Recommendations: It is recommended that meetings be limited to 30 minutes. It is also recommended that agendas be circulated in advance. A follow-up survey should be conducted in six months.

body: Treine esta habilidade com o formato de tarefas curtas das provas (TOEFL/IELTS).
Leia o enunciado primeiro e procure as palavras-chave.
Use exemplos reais da vida dos alunos e peça frases próprias.
Corrija o erro mais frequente da aula em grupo, sem expor o aluno.
Retome o conteúdo na aula seguinte com um exercício curto.
